identity.only_variable: maximum consecutive bars since the directional prior-96 net move first reached 8 percent
identity.trend_definition: short requires prior-96 net move >= +8%; long requires prior-96 net move <= -8%; age counts consecutive completed observation bars in the same direction
identity.label_boundary: candidate construction reads no fill, future candle, MFE, MAE, exit, PnL, R, win, or loss fields

coverage.universe_limitation: current-live Top60 is a partial diagnostic with survivorship bias; it is not a point-in-time historical universe or OOS proof

clarified_exit_contract.partial_close_trigger: first post-entry return to the causally active Bollinger middle band
clarified_exit_contract.final_exit_plan: close all remaining quantity at the opposite outer-band proximity or +5 initial R, whichever occurs first; mirror long and short
clarified_exit_contract.unresolved: outer-band proximity distance and same-15m-bar trigger ordering remain unregistered
